annotations.title: Get company news with sources and freshness

description: Get cached company news for one exact Bullrun ticker, newest publication first, with publisher, source URL, publication date and stored-fetch freshness when recorded. Optional since cutoff and limit up to 50; only the newest 50 stored articles are searched. Useful for company headlines and article sources; use get_corporate_calendar for scheduled earnings/dividends and get_earnings_call_transcript for call text. Reading news also registers demand and requests a best-effort background cache refresh; this response does not wait for or confirm a refresh. Cached/empty/stale results do not establish that no new events exist. Does not change portfolios or place trades.

limit.description: Maximum returned articles, newest publication first. Up to 50 cached source articles are read before cutoff filtering.

since.description: Inclusive publication-time cutoff. YYYY-MM-DD means midnight UTC; timestamps need an explicit Z or UTC offset. Applied to the newest 50 stored articles, not a full historical news archive.

ticker.description: Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP, ABBN or 6324.T. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.
